title: restructure — irrigation

sentences.sentence: proposals to radically restructure Britain’s electronics industry
sentences.translation: 彻底整顿英国电子行业的提议

sentences.sentence: Tax cuts provided the stimulus which the slow economy needed.
sentences.translation: 减税为不景气的经济带来了其所需的刺激。

sentences.sentence: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
sentences.translation: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

phrases.translation: 工程学院；工业学院；工科院

工业学院，技术学院；技术研究所；初级技术学院
乔治亚理工学院（美国大学）
学院；就读学校；毕业院校

sentences.sentence: research institutes
sentences.translation: 研究所

phrases.translation: 植物生化学；植物生物化学

sentences.sentence: ...the effects of air pollutants on the biochemistry of plants or animals.
sentences.translation: …大气污染物对植物或动物生化过程的影响。

sentences.sentence: “You have to be an optimist to be an inventor or entrepreneur, ” he concludes.
sentences.translation: 要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

sentences.sentence: If any of you end up being entrepreneur, which I hope you will be, what do you have in store for yourself, and what does that journey look like?
sentences.translation: 如果你们当中任何一个人成了企业家，这也是我希望你们做到的，你自己会有什么样的储备，那样的一段旅程又将是什么样的？

sentences.sentence: How would you define personal growth as an entrepreneur?
sentences.translation: 你会如何定义,一个企业家的个人成长？

sentences.sentence: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
sentences.translation: 外交部出现了危机。

sentences.sentence: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
sentences.translation: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

sentences.sentence: The plane ascended rapidly.
sentences.translation: 飞机迅速爬升。

sentences.sentence: a combination nightclub and café
sentences.translation: 夜总会兼咖啡馆

sentences.sentence: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
sentences.translation: 我不可能给你明确的答复。

sentences.sentence: We need to record sufficient data to enable definite conclusions to be reached.
sentences.translation: 我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。

sentences.sentence: He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
sentences.translation: 他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

sentences.sentence: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
sentences.translation: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

phrases.translation: n. 程序设计；程式设计
n. 发展计划；开发方案

sentences.sentence: He only pursues writing-only careers like novelist, journalist or copyrighter, when instead, he could have looked into being a minister, public relations assistant, editor or government lobbyist.
sentences.translation: 他只追求纯写作的职业，比如小说家、记者或剧作家，而实际上，他也可以找代理人、公共关系助手、编辑或政府说客之类的工作。

translations.translation: 过剩的；失业的，被解雇的

sentences.sentence: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
sentences.translation: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

sentences.sentence: This alternative would have to operate as any other insurer, on the basis of the premiums it collects.
sentences.translation: 这个选项如同其他的保险公司一样，依靠它收取的保费生存。

sentences.sentence: At some moments in this crisis it has shown the way—by agreeing to supply dollars to countries that needed them, and by guaranteeing the contracts of European banks when it rescued a big insurer.
sentences.translation: 在这次危机的某些时刻，美国显示出了这一做法，同意提供美元给需要的国家，而且当欧洲的银行在援救一个大保险公司的时候，担保它们的合约。

sentences.sentence: In between these visits, at the request of the hospital manager, I am constantly on the phone to my travel insurance party, as neither hospital nor insurer seems to accept what the other is saying.
sentences.translation: 在那些探视者来访的间隙，按照医院经理的要求，我不断地和我的保险公司打电话，因为无论是医院还是保险公司似乎都不认同对方所说的情况。

sentences.sentence: He tends to overestimate his own abilities.
sentences.translation: 他往往高估自己的能力。

sentences.sentence: The importance of training in health and safety cannot be overestimated (= is extremely important ).
sentences.translation: 对健康和安全方面的培训极为重要。

sentences.sentence: In addition to property damage, the floods have affected some of the nation's most fertile cropland, and are expected to have an impact on already rising food prices, especially for crops like corn.
sentences.translation: 除了财产损失之外，洪水还影响了美国一部分最肥沃的耕地，并预计对已经不断增加的粮食价格有所影响，尤其是像玉米这样的农作物。

sentences.sentence: But it is "crucial" that farmers are not encouraged to use productive cropland to grow biofuel crops, it says.
sentences.translation: 但是该报告说，关键在于不要鼓励农民使用富饶的农田种植生物燃料作物。

sentences.sentence: Fly ash uranium sometimes leaches into the soil and water surrounding a coal plant, affecting cropland and, in turn, food.
sentences.translation: 浮尘中含有的铀有时会溶入煤电厂周围的土壤和水体中，影响农田，进而影响食物。

sentences.sentence: Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
sentences.translation: 江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。

sentences.sentence: In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
sentences.translation: 与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 60 单元

restructure
音标：英 /riː'strʌktʃə/  美 /ri'strʌktʃɚ/
v. 调整，重建
例句：proposals to radically restructure Britain’s electronics industry
彻底整顿英国电子行业的提议

stimulus
音标：英 /'stɪmjʊləs/  美 /'stɪmjələs/
n. 刺激
短语：economic stimulus — 经济刺激
短语：stimulus package — 刺激计划
短语：fiscal stimulus — 财政刺激
例句：Tax cuts provided the stimulus which the slow economy needed.
减税为不景气的经济带来了其所需的刺激。

feasible
音标：英 /'fiːzɪb(ə)l/  美 /'fizəbl/
adj. 可行的
短语：feasible solution — 可行解释；适宜解
短语：feasible region — [化]可行域；[计]可行区域；[经]可行性区域
短语：economically feasible — 经济上可行的，经济上合算
例句：a feasible solution
可行的解决方法

adaptation
音标：英 /ædəp'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ædæp'teʃən/

例句：Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

institute

短语：plant biochemistry — 植物生化学；植物生物化学

entrepreneur
音标：英 /ˌɒntrəprəˈnɜː(r)/  美 /ˌɑntrəprəˈnɝ​/
n. 企业家

要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

如果你们当中任何一个人成了企业家，这也是我希望你们做到的，你自己会有什么样的储备，那样的一段旅程又将是什么样的？
例句：How would you define personal growth as an entrepreneur?
你会如何定义,一个企业家的个人成长？

definite
音标：英 /'defɪnɪt/  美 /'dɛfɪnət/

我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。
例句：He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

preserve
音标：英 /prɪ'zɜːv/  美 /prɪ'zɝv/
v. 保存，保护

例句：We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

redundant
音标：英 /rɪ'dʌnd(ə)nt/  美 /rɪ'dʌndənt/
adj. 过剩的；失业的，被解雇的
短语：redundant information — 冗余信息
短语：redundant system — [计]冗余系统
短语：redundant code — 冗余码
例句：Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

insurer
音标：英 /ɪn'ʃʊərə/  美 /ɪn'ʃʊrɚ/
n. 保险公司；承保人
例句：This alternative would have to operate as any other insurer, on the basis of the premiums it collects.
这个选项如同其他的保险公司一样，依靠它收取的保费生存。
例句：At some moments in this crisis it has shown the way—by agreeing to supply dollars to countries that needed them, and by guaranteeing the contracts of European banks when it rescued a big insurer.
在这次危机的某些时刻，美国显示出了这一做法，同意提供美元给需要的国家，而且当欧洲的银行在援救一个大保险公司的时候，担保它们的合约。
例句：In between these visits, at the request of the hospital manager, I am constantly on the phone to my travel insurance party, as neither hospital nor insurer seems to accept what the other is saying.
在那些探视者来访的间隙，按照医院经理的要求，我不断地和我的保险公司打电话，因为无论是医院还是保险公司似乎都不认同对方所说的情况。

overestimate
音标：英 /əʊvər'estɪmeɪt/  美 /,ovər'ɛstɪmət/
v. 高估
例句：He tends to overestimate his own abilities.
他往往高估自己的能力。
例句：The importance of training in health and safety cannot be overestimated (= is extremely important ).
对健康和安全方面的培训极为重要。

cropland
音标：英 /'krɒp,lænd/  美 /'krɑp,lænd/
n. 农田
例句：In addition to property damage, the floods have affected some of the nation's most fertile cropland, and are expected to have an impact on already rising food prices, especially for crops like corn.
除了财产损失之外，洪水还影响了美国一部分最肥沃的耕地，并预计对已经不断增加的粮食价格有所影响，尤其是像玉米这样的农作物。
例句：But it is "crucial" that farmers are not encouraged to use productive cropland to grow biofuel crops, it says.
但是该报告说，关键在于不要鼓励农民使用富饶的农田种植生物燃料作物。
例句：Fly ash uranium sometimes leaches into the soil and water surrounding a coal plant, affecting cropland and, in turn, food.
浮尘中含有的铀有时会溶入煤电厂周围的土壤和水体中，影响农田，进而影响食物。

irrigation
音标：英 /ˌɪrɪˈɡeʃn/  美 /ˌɪrɪˈɡeʃn/
n. 灌溉
短语：irrigation works — 灌溉结构物
短语：irrigation water — 灌溉用水
短语：drip irrigation — 滴灌；滴流灌溉
短语：irrigation system — 灌溉系统，浇灌系统
短语：irrigation equipment — 灌溉设备
短语：furrow irrigation — 沟灌，畦灌；畦沟灌溉
短语：border irrigation — 畦灌；带状灌溉
短语：spray irrigation — 喷水灌溉；喷洒灌溉法
短语：irrigation canal — 灌溉渠，浇灌渠
短语：surface irrigation — 地面灌溉；地面浇灌
短语：irrigation ditch — 灌溉水渠；农渠
短语：flood irrigation — 淹灌；漫灌
短语：irrigation channel — 灌溉渠，灌渠；进水渠道
短语：drop irrigation — 点滴灌溉
短语：irrigation network — 灌溉网
短语：trickle irrigation — 滴灌；滴灌系统
例句：Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。
例句：In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。
